description: This file defines a React functional component 'ViewDetailsModal' that renders a modal dialog displaying detailed information about a JSON data object. It includes utility functions for formatting labels and currency values, and it supports custom display logic for particular data keys such as 'user cost'. The component is designed for reuse across an application to present versatile JSON details.

methods.name: ViewDetailsModal
methods.description: React component that renders a modal displaying key-value pairs of a provided JSON object, with special formatting for certain keys like user costs.
